view_notes: north rear view (nose away from camera; the character's LEFT is screen LEFT): back of the auburn head with upper-left sheen and swept-back strand lines; low centred braided coil at the nape; cool grey-white medical scarf wrapped at the neck with the long tail down the char-left back; ivory clinician coat closed over the back with shoulder yoke, centre seam and lower vent revealing the charcoal underdress; pale grey-white apron tied in a bow at the back with side wrap edges; slim leather belt with a small medicine pouch at the char-right back; dark-red emergency bag with brass clasps, leather handle and rolled bandage on the character's LEFT hip (screen LEFT), hung from a leather cross-body strap with a brass adjuster; small green herb sprig tucked at the char-right back waist; both ivory sleeves, pale cuffs and dark gloves visible from behind, char-left hand on the bag; brown leather boots seen from behind with folded cuffs, brass eyelets, stacked heels and soles
authored_deviations_from_sheet: North is a true rear view re-authored from the same identity contract, not a horizontal flip, recolour or upscale of the south or west static.

The concept sheet is front-facing; the north view deliberately shows no eyes, nose or mouth. The canonical restrained patient smile remains part of the character identity and is carried by the south/west views, not invented on the back of the head.
The white head-veil is omitted so the Bible's low auburn braided coil remains readable; the grey-white medical scarf is wrapped at the neck with its tail down the back.
The sheet's long dark-red shawl is reduced to the canonical dark-red emergency bag on the character's left hip (screen left in rear view).
The apron is worn in front, so from behind only its waist ties, bow, tails and side wrap edges are shown; this is an explicit rear-view readability choice, not a second apron.
The herb sprig is at the char-right chest in front views; in the rear view it is tucked at the char-right back waist so the identity colour remains present without a floating prop.
Fine embroidery, bag contents, tassels and multiple belt charms beyond the botanical hem motif, brass clasps and rolled bandage are omitted for 48 px readability.
